text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock E, B, and D after gains; I should not sell just to lock in a win if the investment case still holds.","I should judge each stock by its prospects and its role in my whole portfolio, not treat it as a separate account or anchor on my average cost.","Because I trade and check in rarely, I should set clear review and rebalancing rules in advance rather than let inaction or reluctance to admit a mistake drive decisions."]}
